question: Can the new pidfd-bearing PhysicalCohortWitness candidate be minted from the exact retained spawn_held_cohort lifecycle without weakening the physical barrier evidence boundary?
observed_lifecycle: spawn_held_cohort waits until all children have emitted ready markers while still alive at the common barrier
the parent observes child PIDs and read-only S1 file descriptors while the barrier is held
the parent then writes the release file
only after release does the parent call proc.communicate for every child and obtain each final NODE_RESULT packet
spawn_held_cohort returns packets and proof only after those communicate calls complete and parent_observed_exit_ns has been recorded
pidfd_candidate_behavior: mint_barrier_witness requires ready_by_node, fd bindings, S1 file identity and physical predicates
mint_barrier_witness calls os.pidfd_open(pid, 0) for every observed PID
the candidate states that minting must occur while the exact process handles can be opened at the barrier
require_physical_witness later uses os.fstat(pidfd) only as descriptor-validity checking

new_blocker.claim: The current retained observer API returns the data needed by an external mint_barrier_witness caller only after release/communicate, whereas the pidfd candidate needs process handles opened while the cohort is still the exact barrier cohort. A naive post-return integration therefore cannot establish the intended mint-at-barrier provenance and may fail once children have been reaped.
new_blocker.counterhypothesis: pidfd_open may still succeed for an exited child while it remains an unreaped zombie, so opening immediately after return could preserve process identity.
new_blocker.adjudication: The retained spawn_held_cohort uses subprocess.Popen.communicate, which waits for process termination and performs wait/reaping. Linux pidfd_open documents that post-termination opening is only guaranteed while the process has not been reaped. Therefore the post-return path must not be treated as a reliable barrier-time minting mechanism.
new_blocker.falsifier: Demonstrate an exact-current source path that opens and binds pidfds before release/reap while simultaneously binding the exact packet/read-receipt/cohort data later consumed by the sole retained coordinator, without a caller-forgeable reconstruction step.

linux_semantics.observed_rule: pidfd_open returns a stable descriptor for a task; opening after termination is only guaranteed while the child remains a zombie and has not been reaped
linux_semantics.poll_rule: a pidfd becomes readable when the referenced task exits and produces hangup after reaping; therefore descriptor validity alone is not equivalent to current liveness

design_direction.preferred: Move witness minting into the retained barrier observation lifecycle before release rather than minting from a returned proof dictionary.
minimum_shape: while all ten children are held at the barrier, open pidfds and bind the exact process identities
make the exact NODE_RESULT packet or a cryptographically complete packet commitment available before barrier release, so the witness can bind the same packets later admitted
bind S1 device/inode plus per-node read-only fd observations and read-receipt/snapshot identity into the witness before release
only then release children and complete output collection
on post-release packet collection, require exact equality with the pre-release commitment before any mutation
route physical admission through the sole retained coordinator with explicit PHYSICAL_OBSERVED evidence class; keep SOURCE_FIXTURE_ONLY disjoint
do not treat os.fstat(pidfd) as proof that the child is still alive; use pidfd poll/wait semantics only for the claim actually needed
implementation_options: extend the child ready marker to include the complete NODE_RESULT packet or packet_digest computed while its read transaction is still held
or introduce a held-cohort session/context object that exposes a mint callback at the barrier and does not release/reap until the callback has bound the witness

next_exact_action: Fuse pidfd acquisition into the live barrier phase itself and bind a pre-release exact NODE_RESULT commitment; then make the sole retained physical coordinator require that observation-bound capability and keep synthetic source-fixture admission explicitly disjoint.
